title: P3 monitor/script_run: arguments
description: The built-in write tool monitor/script_run {resource, script}. A resource from the catalog with monitor_host, a script name from hosts[].monitor_scripts_allowed of the catalog whose scriptid is in the latest adapter list; names from the monitoring system API do not get into the enum (INJ-16). Every initiator has monitor.script_run (D-73).

script.description: Script name from monitor_scripts_allowed of the catalog.
